name: Warm Cosy Interior Illustration
description: Warm painted illustration with soft digital brushwork in browns, cream and amber with muted greens, inviting and quiet, detailed and never photographic.
style_bible: A warm image painted in soft digital brush, in the register of an illustrated magazine plate rather than a photograph. Medium and surface: soft painterly digital art with visible brush groupings — broad blended planes, looser scumbled strokes across surfaces, and a few crisper marks reserved for the nearest forms. There is no photographic texture, no lens blur and no three-dimensional gloss. Palette: warm browns, cream and amber across the lit surfaces, held against muted greens. Warm colours dominate; the greens stay quiet and slightly grey rather than forming a competing scheme. Lighting: gentle warm light — one or two warm sources inside the frame, each with a soft halo and a gentle falloff that lets the corners settle into a warm half-dark. Cool light may enter as a clearly weaker secondary note. Never an even flood of light and never a harsh key. Composition: real depth — a near surface in the foreground, a middle plane, and a further plane beyond. Clean and uncluttered enough to read at card size, inviting and calm, with no drama. No recognisable brand or legible lettering. Keep the contract content-independent: no copied composition.
